title: FINTRUST: A Comprehensive Benchmark of Trustworthiness Evaluation in Finance Domain

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual substitution of sensitive attributes (age, gender, and race) in a binary classification credit scoring task (using the German Credit Dataset) to evaluate the stability and consistency of the model's loan default predictions.

Masked token prediction task where models suggest "buy" or "sell" for companies across different sectors (from the Russell 3000 index), using Cohen's d to quantify the variance in recommendation probabilities across different industries.
